item.title: N.Sembilan data center: Water supply for industry will be developed – Aminuddin
item.description: SEREMBAN: The state government will develop new alternative water sources for use in the industrial sector, including to accommodate the operations of three data centres to be built in Negeri Sembilan. Menteri Besar, Datuk Seri Aminuddin Harun said the move was to ensure that the development involved would not affect the water supply to residents.
